notes.title: Early Access Release Notes - Version 0.5.1
notes.content:
New features / content / improvements:

   Added Italian to the language select options (many thanks to Thomas “Tamaster” Di Angelis)
   Added lots of community Techs into the population that were previously rejected because they were overloaded and could not move at all, as recent changes now allow them to move slowly whilst overloaded.
   Added lots of legacy Community Techs to the population (200 approximately).
   Performance optimisations on spawning Techs and general gameplay.
   Added GSO Shield charging visual effect.


Game Design Tweaks:

   Balanced the Full Compression Friction of all wheels so that even when overloaded, wheels can still move slowly.
   Tweaked the Venture Wheels to be fast, but still reasonably controllable.
   Re-arranged the Terra Firma checkpoint track slightly to avoid some scenery elements.
   Reduced the weight of the GSO drills to help the starting Techs to balance.
   Increased the weight of GeoCorp Cabs up to expected weight.
   Increased the top speed of all GeoCorp Wheels.
   Increased the carry strength of GSO Wheels and the Smaller Venture Wheel a little bit.
   Increased the health of all EXP Half Blocks to act as suitable armour.
   Reduced the weight of all resource chunks, as they now exert opposing force upon Techs whilst being carried.
   Increased X axis rotation speed of GSO ZK-47, Venture Hail Fire Rifle and added rotation for EXP Oozee.
   Increased the Y axis movement of all guns, except the Megaton which is slightly decreased.
   Decreased rotation speed of GSO 3-Pound Cannon and EXP Megaton Cannon
   Increased HP of GeoCorp armour.
   Reduced kickback on GSO ZK-47 Machine Gun.
   Reduced damage dealt by the GSO Mini Drill, GSO Rock Drill and increased the damage of the GeoCorp Triple Bore.
   Slightly increased the initial revs of all GeoCorp Wheels.
   Moved the Resource Givers in the Test Chamber away from the ramp.
   Batteries are now more expensive, weigh more and will explode when destroyed.


Bug Fixes:

   Fixed Cabs acting as AI modules.
   Improved holding-beam physics & reduced item bobbing.
   Solar generator no longer infinitely powers a bubble shield.
   Fixed changed recipes showing in the fabricator and refinery menus.
   Pressing spacebar no longer fires the gun while naming snapshots.
   Can no longer drag a single resource across 2 fabricator slots.

notes.title: Early Access Release Notes - Version 0.5.0
notes.content:
New features / content / improvements:

   Added lots of new community Techs to the population.
   New weapon sounds added.
   Added new GSO Mini Drill to the Game.

   It is now given during the tutorial instead of the plough (as it is more useful than the plough).
   It is available in the R&D Test Chamber (behind the older GSO Rock Drill.
   The Mini Drill is purchasable from the Payload Terminal.
   The Mini Drill can be crafted in a 2-Slot Fabricator with 1x Plumbia Ingot and 1x Titania Ingot.

   The crafting recipe changes were made to allow room the new Mini Drill to fit into the 2-Slot Fabricator comfortably and with a logical recipe (hard metal thing plus normal metal thing) and to remove an exploit that allowed for Fulmenia to be yielded by scrapping Rock Drills (which were a bit too common for such a rare resource).
   Added a warning for overloaded wheels.
   Added animations to the GSO Solar generator folding out and folding away.
   Re-ordered languages in language select dropdown menu to appear alphabetically


Game Design Tweaks:

   Further weapon balancing:

   GSO ZK-47 now does 108DPS, a slight decrease.
   GSO COIL Laser still does 105DPS, but now fires faster with less damage per shot.
   GSO 3-Pound Cannon nerfed back down to 133DPS.
   GSO STUD Laser keeps 130DPS, but also becomes faster firing with less damage per shot.
   VEN Hail Fire Rifle increased significantly to 222DPS, recoil increased.
   GSO Mortar has a tiny buff to 235DPS.
   EXP Oozee significant buff to 421DPS.
   EXP Megaton Cannon tuned down to 450DPS.

   The GSO ZK-47 Machine Gun has had it’s recoil reduced to ensure the starting Tech is more stable with the drill attached.
   The GSO Plough is now craftable by combining 2x Titania Ingots in a 2-Slot Fabricator.
   The GSO Rock Drill (older drill) has also had it’s recipe changed. It is now craftable with 1x Plumbia Ingot and 2x Titania Ingots in a 3-Slot Fabricator.


Bug Fixes:

   Fixed ability to drop resources onto base refineries, fabricators and delivery cannon.

   The GSO Rock Drill (older drill) has also had it’s recipe changed. It is now craftable with 1x Plumbia Ingot and 2x Titania Ingots in a 3-Slot Fabricator.


Bug Fixes:

   Fixed ability to drop resources onto base refineries, fabricators and delivery cannon.

notes.title: Early Access Release Notes - Version 0.4.17
notes.content:
New features / content / improvements:

   The key config screen now displays correctly at different screen resolutions and aspect ratios.
   Added the EXP Medium Battery and EXP Medium Generator to the R&D Pack.
   Added a confirmation screen when starting new game to prevent accidental save loss.
   Added Brazilian Portuguese to the language select list (many thanks to Sys Gabriel and Alex Nunes).
   Updated Dutch translations (many thanks to Neo and Tim).
   Updated German translations (many thanks to José and SRQ).
   Updated Polish translations (many thanks to Szymek).
   Updated Portuguese translations (many thanks to João).
   Updated Russian translations (many thanks to Anton and Honcharuk).


Game Design Tweaks:

   Fixed the Lumber Joe, Jack and Jill Techs so that their AI modules now face forwards (avoiding the strange beam behaviour).
   Added some Venture Techs that feature the Nose Cone Prop to the population (as created on the stream by Anton and Jamie).
   Added a selection of Community Techs and some more Venture Nose Prop Techs.
   Balanced the fuel capacity of all cabs and their refill rates (Each cab has a small built in fuel tank).
   Balanced weapons:

   GSO Machine Gun does 37HP per shot * 4 shots per second = 148DPS (damage per second), more recoil added (to make it feel more powerful)

   GSO Laser now does 66HP per shot (previously 60HP) * 1.2 shots per second = 80DPS, increased damage, recoil added

   GSO 3 Pound now does 150HP per shot * 1 shot per second = 150DPS, increased damage, increased range from 25 to 45, more recoil added

   GSO Stud Laser now does 125HP per shot * 1 shot per second = 125DPS, increased damage, recoil added

   VEN Hailfire now does 24HP per shot * 10 per second = 240DPS, increased damage overall, increased range to 50 and the bullet spray is reduced by half, slightly more recoil added

   GSO Mortar now does 75HP per shot * 4 shots per second = 300DPS (previously 240DPS), increased damage slightly, increased range to 35, added recoil

   EXP Oozee now does 5HP per shot * 80 shots per second = 400DPS (previously 2400DPS), decreased damage overall, but increased range to 40 and reduced bullet spray by half and weapon recoil to a more reasonable level.

   EXP Megaton now does 600HP per shot * 1 shot per second = 600DPS (previously 450), increased damage, increased range to 90 and recoil greatly increased.



Bug Fixes:

   Fixed issue with Twitter authorisation.
   Turned off the low battery warnings for all generators (all generators have small internal batteries).

notes.title: Early Access Release Notes - Version 0.4.15
notes.content:
New features / content / improvements:

   Ability to buy blocks from Payload Terminal.
   Graduated the Armour Plates from EXP to GeoCorp (now available for all players).
   Graduated the Right Angle Bracket from EXP to Venture (now available for all players).


Game Design Tweaks:

   Balanced the values of Batteries, Solar Generators, Generator Fuel Sources, Bubbles and the Remote Charger:

   A Solar Generator will fill a Battery in around 20 seconds.
   A single Battery at full charge will keep a Shield up for around 10 minutes and can withstand a serious attack for around 10 seconds.
   The Remote Charger will now fill a Battery from empty in around 30 seconds.

Bug Fixes:

   Moved AI Module on all presets that had it facing the wrong direction to stop them getting confused about their facing in beam mode.
   Updated the Payload Terminal pre-loaded Techs with the new AI Module changes.

notes.title: Early Access Release Notes - Version 0.4.13 + 0.4.14
notes.content:
New features / content / improvements:

   Added a Payload Terminal (shop block) to the initial Repair Base.
   Payload Terminal offers ability to buy previously snapshotted Techs and bases as well as some default designs.
   Added a recipe for the Payload Terminal to the 2 Slot Fabricator.

   Updated the price of some blocks.

   Moved some of the Hill Hopper checkpoints around to avoid rocks and other scenery objects.
   The R&D Test Chamber no longer shows a speedometer.


Bug Fixes:

   [0.4.14] Fixed issue with older game saves not loading properly.
   Prevent Generator working while unanchored.
   Fixed snapshots not restoring a base’s anchor state.
   Don’t fade UI when background fight fades in Main Menu.
   Jackhammer now does damage.
   Data snapshots not showing image sometimes on the Mac version.

notes.title: Early Access Release Notes - Version 0.4.10
notes.content:
New features / content / improvements:

   Undo feature added when more than 1 block is removed from a Tech or base.
   Gun warning can now auto dismiss when it has a line of sight again.
   Animation added to Scrapper base block.
   Dutch option added to language select with initial translations (many thanks Neo and MissDonkey).


Game Design Tweaks:

   There is now a 75% chance that blocks will be destroyed when detached from enemies in the main game mode. This change is to reduce the amount of blocks that are gained from a defeated enemy, which would sometimes jump the player’s progress too far forward, too quickly.
   Invaders now have the amount of charged batteries limited to a maximum of 5.
   Moved the armour plates over to GeoCorp in R&D and the Right Angle Bracket to Venture.
   Added more new enemy vehicles.


Bug Fixes:

   Fixed problem of base conveyors not working sometimes.
   Fixed bug where chunks jump between conveyors on different Techs.
   Fixed block dragging/anchoring behaviour.

notes.title: Early Access Release Notes - Version 0.4.6
notes.content:
New features / content / improvements:

   Improved AI avoidance
   Respawn beginner vehicle on death
   Reduced size of Invaders
   Moved Remote Charger from EXP to GSO. Also made available in Main Game and added to crafting table. 
   We can now individually control mass, friction and restitution per chunk type. Meaning we can make Sap, Oleite and wheels bouncy!
   Lowering profile of warning icons
   New Resource assets
   Updated localisation document.
   General polish


Game Design Tweaks:

   Small changes to the fabricator example base.
   Auto aim guns now reselect new targets more regularly.
   Added Scrapper Cost Multiplier.
   Removed the last of the ugly world space arrows from the challenge modes.
   Warning overlays now have a curve to determine how often they should display.
   Removed some buttons from the pause menu.
   New block discovery overlays now appear on all undiscovered new blocks that get detached / are available.
   Warning overlays now revert to a blinking state after their full warning message has been read at least once.
   Block discovery overlays now dismiss when the target item is picked up.
   Once an overlay has been expanded and read, players can click anywhere else to dismiss it, despite the state of the overlay.
   Invaders are now removed from play when they defeat you.


Bug Fixes:

   Fixed issue where brakes aren’t released on boost unless actually boosting.
   Tech's with only anchors count as legitimate and so will not self destruct.
   Fixed Tech staying kinematic after anchor removed.
   Made sure anchored Techs are always flat and always anchor when loading them back into games.
   Made sure detached enemy AI controllers always destruct.
   Fixed chunk duplication bug.
   Fixed logic fail preventing unanchored tanks from clearing kinematic.
   Fixed AI controllers trying to beam up fixed bases.
   Unanchoring an anchored tech causes it to fall apart.
   Anchored blocks set as root when no controller exists.
   Fixed delivery cannon, more robust way to cancel holding animations, allow animated item to retain velocity on animation exit.
   Fixed booster/brakes sticking bug.
   Various fixes to Sumo including; Sumo spawn height & centred, beam enable/disable conditions, game-breaking UI logic bug & block decode message.
   Fixed bug relating to anchors applying on all parts that could when spawning Techs. Now only ones that were anchored when the Tech was saved will re-anchor.
   Fixed the tractor pad holding beams to hold items with a bit more strength so they are not dropped all the time when moving at speed.
   Fixes to the issues with some Attach Points not showing when they should, during rebuilds.
   Clean-up work has gone into the chunk drag and drop logic.

notes.title: Beta Access Release Notes - Version 0.3.6
notes.content:

   Hub Wheel block added to the Test Chamber.
   Cow Catcher Plough block added to the Test Chamber.
   Angled half blocks added to the Test Chamber.



Bug fixes:

   The base no longer loses its anchor when loading a saved game.
   Fixed a gap in the Sumo arena between the main floor and outer edge.


Known issues and bugs:

   The menu options incorrectly disappear when the background fades to black to transition to a new environment.

   Pinned recipes in the base menu screens

   Base: Aspects of the Base UI are missing or have placeholder content.

   Can now save at any point in the main game.
   Music and sound volume settings are now available in the sound settings screen.
   New ambient environment sounds.
   Added the Block Silo to the list of blocks that can have their recipe unlocked then fabricated.
   New models for the Emerald sources.
   Tweaked the plough to close the gap when 2 are placed next to each other.
   Tractor pads now attract resources from a greater height.
   R&D Pack:

   The vehicle size limit in the R&D Test Chamber has been increased to 64x64x64 units.
   Ramps have been added to the R&D Test Chamber.



Bug fixes:

   The base position is now saved to prevent the base moving when repeatedly being unloaded and loaded.
   Vehicle blocks cannot be attached to the base now.
   Holes in the terrain with giant shards have now been fixed.
   A gap in the mid-ground of the terrain where 2 different levels of detail join is now correctly stiched together.
   Prevent vehicle snapshot retweets being incorrectly attributed to the person retweeting.
   Fixed flickering attach points when building.
   When a vehicle has multiple tractor pads, resources now go into the base as expected.
   Can no longer inadvertently tractor pad resources off the base.
   Fixed issue that allowed Venture wheels to intersect other parts of the vehicle.


Known issues and bugs:

   Game save: Certain game data is not saved currently:

   Pinned recipes in the base menu screens

   Game save: The game will not save when clicking on the close window button in windowed mode of by pressing Alt+F4 to close the game.
   Base: Aspects of the Base UI are missing or have placeholder content.
   Base: It is possible to jam the player's vehicle under the base.
   A drone vehicle with a cab but no AI module drives away from the base instead of staying idle.

notes.title: Beta Access Release Notes - Version 0.2.5
notes.content:
Wednesday 24th September 2014

New features / content / improvements:

   Base shield now functions correctly:

   When active, prevents enemies from entering the shield.
   Prevents enemy bullets from passing through the shield.
   Takes damage and shrinks when attacked by enemies.

   Turning base blocks can now be fabricated and can be used to build automated sentries by attaching a cab and weapons.
   New Venture Corporation blocks:

   Venture POD Cab
   Standard Block
   Long Block
   Globe Trotter Wheel
   Dirt Digger Wheel
   Kompress Fuel Tank
   G-Boy Spoiler

   The tutorial messages and steps have been refined to explain more details to the player.
   The image of the base components no longer displays text that is explained in the tutorials. 
   Fans can now be fabricated at the base.
   Downward facing fans can now spin via Shift key.
   The checkpoints have been visually improved and all checkpoints are now pairs of gates to go through.
   The checkpoints in the Hover Bother challenge have had their positions tweaked.
   Trees and resource rocks now have a greater variation of shapes.
   GSO Fixed Drill now does twice as much damage.


Bug fixes:

   When starting a new game or new challenge, the screen fades from black until the terrain is appearing correctly.
   Oil resources are no longer missing from the world.
   Friendly fire is now prevented from occurring.
   It's now possible to close the Twitter authentication page without authorising by using the back button or pressing Esc.


Major known issues and bugs:

   When enemy vehicles collide with the base shield, they instantly disappear instead of bouncing off.
   When a block is fabricated at the base, it incorrectly collides with the shield and can be rapidly repelled away if released inside the shield.


Other known issues and bugs:

   When a vehicle has multiple tractor pads, it may be tricky getting resources from the vehicle's tractor pads onto the base receiver.
   It is possible to jam the player's vehicle under the base.
   Base components other than the receiver should not pass objects back to vehicles.
   A drone vehicle with a cab but no AI module drives away from the base instead of staying idle.
   There are some graphical holes in the terrain.

notes.title: Beta Release Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.2.3 - Monday 8th September 2014

New features / content / improvements:

   Improved the response time of the in-game cursor.
   Tweaked game balancing values for enemy vehicles:
[olist]
   Reduced the number of enemy vehicles being spawned in the first waves.
   Enemies now spawn further away from the player
   The calculation for size and firepower of enemy vehicles relative to the player vehicle(s) has been turned down a bit.
   The rate of degradation of blocks knocked off enemy vehicles has been doubled so they should like twice as long before they self-destruct.
[/olist]


Bug fixes:

   The shield of the player’s base no longer heals enemy vehicle blocks.
   Right-clicking on the base menus no longer rotates the game camera.


Known issues and bugs:

   The shield does not repel enemy vehicles yet.
   When a vehicle has multiple tractor pads, it may be tricky getting resources from the vehicle's tractor pads onto the base receiver.
   It is possible to jam the player's vehicle under the base.
   When a damaged block is restored back to full health, the red damage effect does not disappear.
   The damaged components of the base do not restore their health yet.
   When the base shield is destroyed, it should be game over. Instead, the game carries on, allowing the player to attach the base parts to their vehicle.
   Base components other than the receiver should not pass objects back to vehicles.
   A drone vehicle with a cab but no AI module drives away from the base instead of staying idle.


==================================================

Version 0.2.2 - Thursday 4th September 2014

New features / content / improvements:

   Rotating the camera has moved from Left Mouse Button to Right Mouse Button.
   The announcement panel has been tidied up.
   The Twitch button and live streams panel have been tidied up and can now be dismissed.
   A new checkpoint challenge, Hover Bother has been added.


Known issues and bugs:

   The shield does not repel enemy vehicles yet.
   When a vehicle has multiple tractor pads, it may be tricky getting resources from the vehicle's tractor pads onto the base receiver.
   It is possible to jam the player's vehicle under the base.


==================================================

Version 0.2.1 - Friday 29th August 2014

New features / content:

   GSO small wheels, Geo Corp wheels and Geo Corp metal wheels now steer allowing for vehicles to have tighter turning circles.
   The standard cursor is now replaced with a custom TerraTech cursor.
   The base shield is now powered by biofuel, which is refined from wood.
   The base shield size grows and shrinks smoothly instead of snapping to the new size.
   A back button has been added to allow a vehicle snapshot to be cancelled.
   The camera has been improved to cater for vertical flight.
   Guns can now aim up & down based on ballistic trajectory calculation.
   A clock has been added to Sumo Showdown to time matches.
   Esc key mirrors the functionality of the back button.


Bug fixes:

   Major:
   The base refinery will now correctly refine each resource instead of incorrectly grabbing 2 and outputting 1.
   Checkpoint challenges now load the correct biome.
   Trees no longer spawn in a fallen state.



Minor:
   In the Main Menu, it's no longer possible to rotate the camera.
   The cannon weapon is firing at the correct rate i.e. slower than the machine gun.
   When taking a vehicle snapshot, the snapshot button is now hidden to prevent it being clicked on again and generating a blank snapshot.
   Cannot double-click onto the base now.
   At the base, when adding an item to the delivery cannon's queue, left clicking on the queue item quickly will no longer return a multiple of the proper amount of money back.
   The sapphire crystal cacti now cast shadows.


Known issues and bugs:

   The shield does not repel enemy vehicles yet.


==================================================

Version 0.2.0 - Thursday 21st August 2014

New features / content:

   The basic functionality of the base is now working:
   Receiver: Drop off point for resources
   Power Source: Consumes wood to power the base & shield
   Resource Silo: Stores resources, ready to be refined, delivered or fabricated
   Delivery Cannon: Blast resources back to Earth for currency, spend currency on crafting recipes
   Refinery: Turns raw ore into usable refined resources
   Fabricator: Craft refined resources into vehicle blocks and unlock new crafting recipes


Known issues and bugs:

   Major:
   The shield does not repel enemy vehicles yet.
   Checkpoint challenges can load the wrong biome.
   Trees can sometimes spawn in a fallen state.
   At the base, when the refinery has 2 different pinned items in its queue, it will grab 2 resource chunks from the silo, but the output will only be as if one resource chunk went in.
   At the base, when adding an item to the delivery cannon's queue, left clicking on the queue item quickly will return a multiple of the proper amount of money back.



Minor:
   In the Main Menu, it's possible to rotate the camera.
   The cannon weapon is firing at the same rate as the machine gun and should be a lot slower.
   When taking a vehicle snapshot, the button remains active and it's possible to click it again to create a blank thumbnail image.
   It's possible to double-click onto the base which you're not supposed to be able to at the moment.
   The sapphire crystal cacti are not casting shadows.

notes.title: Beta Release Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.2.3 - Monday 8th September 2014

New features / content / improvements:

   Improved the response time of the in-game cursor.
   Tweaked game balancing values for enemy vehicles:
[olist]
   Reduced the number of enemy vehicles being spawned in the first waves.
   Enemies now spawn further away from the player
   The calculation for size and firepower of enemy vehicles relative to the player vehicle(s) has been turned down a bit.
   The rate of degradation of blocks knocked off enemy vehicles has been doubled so they should like twice as long before they self-destruct.
[/olist]


Bug fixes:

   The shield of the player’s base no longer heals enemy vehicle blocks.
   Right-clicking on the base menus no longer rotates the game camera.


Known issues and bugs:

   The shield does not repel enemy vehicles yet.
   When a vehicle has multiple tractor pads, it may be tricky getting resources from the vehicle's tractor pads onto the base receiver.
   It is possible to jam the player's vehicle under the base.
   When a damaged block is restored back to full health, the red damage effect does not disappear.
   The damaged components of the base do not restore their health yet.
   When the base shield is destroyed, it should be game over. Instead, the game carries on, allowing the player to attach the base parts to their vehicle.
   Base components other than the receiver should not pass objects back to vehicles.
   A drone vehicle with a cab but no AI module drives away from the base instead of staying idle.


==================================================

Version 0.2.2 - Thursday 4th September 2014

New features / content / improvements:

   Rotating the camera has moved from Left Mouse Button to Right Mouse Button.
   The announcement panel has been tidied up.
   The Twitch button and live streams panel have been tidied up and can now be dismissed.
   A new checkpoint challenge, Hover Bother has been added.


Known issues and bugs:

   The shield does not repel enemy vehicles yet.
   When a vehicle has multiple tractor pads, it may be tricky getting resources from the vehicle's tractor pads onto the base receiver.
   It is possible to jam the player's vehicle under the base.


==================================================

Version 0.2.1 - Friday 29th August 2014

New features / content:

   GSO small wheels, Geo Corp wheels and Geo Corp metal wheels now steer allowing for vehicles to have tighter turning circles.
   The standard cursor is now replaced with a custom TerraTech cursor.
   The base shield is now powered by biofuel, which is refined from wood.
   The base shield size grows and shrinks smoothly instead of snapping to the new size.
   A back button has been added to allow a vehicle snapshot to be cancelled.
   The camera has been improved to cater for vertical flight.
   Guns can now aim up & down based on ballistic trajectory calculation.
   A clock has been added to Sumo Showdown to time matches.
   Esc key mirrors the functionality of the back button.


Bug fixes:

   Major:
   The base refinery will now correctly refine each resource instead of incorrectly grabbing 2 and outputting 1.
   Checkpoint challenges now load the correct biome.
   Trees no longer spawn in a fallen state.



Minor:
   In the Main Menu, it's no longer possible to rotate the camera.
   The cannon weapon is firing at the correct rate i.e. slower than the machine gun.
   When taking a vehicle snapshot, the snapshot button is now hidden to prevent it being clicked on again and generating a blank snapshot.
   Cannot double-click onto the base now.
   At the base, when adding an item to the delivery cannon's queue, left clicking on the queue item quickly will no longer return a multiple of the proper amount of money back.
   The sapphire crystal cacti now cast shadows.


Known issues and bugs:

   The shield does not repel enemy vehicles yet.


==================================================

Version 0.2.0 - Thursday 21st August 2014

New features / content:

   The basic functionality of the base is now working:
   Receiver: Drop off point for resources
   Power Source: Consumes wood to power the base & shield
   Resource Silo: Stores resources, ready to be refined, delivered or fabricated
   Delivery Cannon: Blast resources back to Earth for currency, spend currency on crafting recipes
   Refinery: Turns raw ore into usable refined resources
   Fabricator: Craft refined resources into vehicle blocks and unlock new crafting recipes


Known issues and bugs:

   Major:
   The shield does not repel enemy vehicles yet.
   Checkpoint challenges can load the wrong biome.
   Trees can sometimes spawn in a fallen state.
   At the base, when the refinery has 2 different pinned items in its queue, it will grab 2 resource chunks from the silo, but the output will only be as if one resource chunk went in.
   At the base, when adding an item to the delivery cannon's queue, left clicking on the queue item quickly will return a multiple of the proper amount of money back.



Minor:
   In the Main Menu, it's possible to rotate the camera.
   The cannon weapon is firing at the same rate as the machine gun and should be a lot slower.
   When taking a vehicle snapshot, the button remains active and it's possible to click it again to create a blank thumbnail image.
   It's possible to double-click onto the base which you're not supposed to be able to at the moment.
   The sapphire crystal cacti are not casting shadows.

notes.title: TerraTech Demo Update - Fri 25 July 2014
notes.content:
Release Notes 

 General: 

   When tall objects such as trees, rocks and crystals obscure view of the vehicle, they now become semi-transparent.
   In Sumo Showdown - Fight (Auto), you can now rotate the camera by clicking and dragging the mouse.
   In Sumo Showdown - Fight (Auto), if all vehicles are immobile and no longer inflicting any damage, then a countdown from 10 will start before a draw is declared.
   In Sumo Showdown, self right vehicles, even if they are being pushed.


 Bug fixes: 

   The game was crashing when trying to tweet a vehicle snapshot. This is now fixed.
   In Sumo design mode, you could not exit beam mode properly (firing a weapon was a workaround). This is now fixed.
   When loading a vehicle into Sumo design and refining the design, sometimes, the pieces used were not removed from the dispensers. This is now fixed.
   The word “SUMO” was not being displayed after the “3, 2, 1” countdown at the start of a Sumo battle.
   In Sumo battles, the digger scoops were not reset to their proper position. This is now fixed.
   The URL bit.ly/myTerraTech was missing from the tweet message template.


 Known issues: 

   No known major issues.
